sourceFile: 2. BRS-161014 Report test find reason NG hearing 2024.1.9_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not usable because it conflates vendor, old/new dome, model, and bending-type tests and reverses the main function conclusion.
issues: Changed factor is an incoherent mix of supplier, dome age, model, bending types, and sample labels.
Baseline/test grouping is invalid; Normal C2 Ralon is compared with E2 and bending rows as if controlled.
Function judgement says improved, but cited conclusion says Ralon has higher NG than Ges and should not be used.
Weight outcomes are misread from headers/sample numbers; source conclusion is Ralon dome is heavier than Ges.
Two sheet/report sections are merged without preserving separate test contexts.
correctionPlan: Split into separate contexts: vendor comparison and Ralon bending separation; keep Report (2) separate if it is a different version.
Set primary changed factor for main report to dome vendor/lot condition: Ges old dome versus Ralon new dome, with C2/E2 and machine/date as subgroups.
Use comparable function rows only and align baseline/test by product, date/test round, and machine where available.
Correct judgement to worse for Ralon versus Ges when supported by rows 73, 75, and conclusion row 79.
Replace bogus measurement stats with dome weight comparison using vendor weight rows and conclusion row 58.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but current citations are overbroad and do not sufficiently support grouping or conclusions.
